items.exampleEn: This new car has low fuel consumption.
The merchant sold silk and spices to other countries.
items.exampleZh: 那位商人把絲綢和香料賣到其他國家。

items.exampleEn: The salesman showed us three different cars.
items.exampleZh: 那位業務員帶我們看了三輛不同的車。

items.exampleEn: The mall was full of shoppers on Saturday.
items.exampleZh: 星期六購物中心擠滿了購物的人。

items.exampleEn: The TV has a two-year warranty.
I asked for a refund because the shoes were too small.
items.exampleZh: 因為鞋子太小，我要求退款。

items.exampleEn: There was a long line at the checkout.
The ship carried goods from many different countries.
items.exampleZh: 那艘船載運來自許多不同國家的貨物。

items.sentenceEn: Please keep your receipt if you want a refund.
items.sentenceZh: 如果你想退款，請保留收據。

items.audioEn: The printer is still under warranty, so the shop will repair it for free.
items.audioZh: 這台印表機還在保固期內，所以店家會免費修理。
items.questionZh: 店家為什麼會免費修理印表機？
options: It is the newest model in the shop.
The owner is a close friend of theirs.

items.sentenceEn: The salesman was polite but talked too much.
items.sentenceZh: 那位業務員很有禮貌，但話太多了。

items.sentenceEn: Shoppers can pay at the self-service checkout.
items.sentenceZh: 購物者可以在自助結帳區付款。

items.stemEn: If the shirt has a hole, you can return it and get a ____.
items.stemZh: 如果襯衫有破洞，你可以退貨並拿回退款。

items.stemEn: People here drink a lot of coffee, so coffee ____ is high.
items.stemZh: 這裡的人喝很多咖啡，所以咖啡的消費量很高。

items.passageEn: Notice to all shoppers: From May 1, Brightway will open three new self-service checkouts. Our sales staff will still be happy to help you choose goods. All our televisions and fridges come with a one-year warranty. Our new fridges use less power, so your power consumption will go down. We also sell goods from local merchants. If you are not happy with an item, you can get a full refund within 30 days. Please keep your receipt.
items.passageZh: 各位顧客請注意：從 5 月 1 日起，Brightway 將新設三台自助結帳機。我們的銷售人員仍然很樂意協助您挑選商品。所有電視和冰箱都附一年保固。我們的新款冰箱比較省電，能降低您的用電量。我們也販售本地商人的商品。如果您對商品不滿意，30 天內可以全額退款。請保留您的收據。

questions.questionZh: 對商品不滿意的話，多久內可以全額退款？

items.promptZh: 這家店的結帳櫃台在哪裡？
referenceEn: Where is the checkout in this shop?
Where can I find the checkout in this store?
rubricZh: 問地點的寫法都可以（例如 Where is…?、Where can I find…?）
時態配合內容（例如問地點多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 這條街以前住了很多有錢的商人。
referenceEn: Many rich merchants used to live on this street.
This street used to be home to many rich merchants.
rubricZh: 用 merchant 表示「商人」（例如 rich merchants）
「以前」可寫，例如 used to、once 等
